ingredients.name: small to medium tomatoes ((about 500 g, 1 pound))
ingredients.raw: 4 small to medium tomatoes ((about 500 g, 1 pound))

steps.instruction: Start by cutting tomatoes into small wedges and finely chop the scallion.
Crack 4 eggs into a bowl and season with ¼ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon white pepper, ½ teaspoon sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon Shaoxing wine. Beat eggs for a minute.
Preheat the wok over medium heat until it just starts to smoke. Then add 2 tablespoons of oil and immediately add the eggs. Scramble the eggs and remove from the wok immediately. Set aside.

Add 1 more tablespoon oil to the wok, turn up the heat to high, and add the tomatoes and scallions. Stir-fry for 1 minute, and then add 2 teaspoons sugar, ½ teaspoon salt, and ¼ cup water (if your stove gets very hot and liquid tends to cook off very quickly in your wok, add a little more water). Add the cooked eggs.
Mix everything together, cover the wok, and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the tomatoes are completely softened.
Uncover, and continue to stir-fry over high heat until the sauce thickens to your liking. Serve!

technique: Prep: 5 mins; Cook: 5 mins; Total: 10 mins; serves 2.
Beat the eggs for 1 minute after adding 1/4 tsp salt, white pepper, sesame oil, and Shaoxing wine.
Use 2 tbsp of the divided oil for the eggs; remove the scrambled eggs immediately, then use the remaining 1 tbsp for the tomatoes.
Start the eggs over medium heat in a wok heated until it just begins to smoke; raise to high heat for the tomatoes and final reduction.
After 1 minute of tomato stir-frying, add sugar, the remaining 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 cup water before returning the eggs.
Cover 1-2 minutes until the tomatoes are completely softened, then uncover and reduce to the desired sauce thickness.
tips: If Shaoxing rice wine is unavailable, the source suggests dry sherry or mirin as a substitute.
If a very hot stove causes liquid to cook off quickly, add a little more water, within the source's raw 1/4-1/2 cup range.
Seasonings and scallion quantity may be adjusted to taste.
sources.rawExcerpt:
菜名：番茄炒蛋
别名：Chinese Tomato Egg Stir-fry
菜系：家常菜
简介：This 10-minute Chinese tomato egg stir-fry is a dish you’ll find on many Chinese home dinner tables. It’s fast, easy, cheap, and delicious. And vegetarian!
原料：4 small to medium tomatoes ((about 500 g, 1 pound))；1 scallion；4 eggs；3/4 tsp salt ((divided, or to taste))；1/4 tsp white pepper；1/2 tsp sesame oil；1 tsp shaoxing wine；3 tbsp vegetable oil ((divided))；2 tsp sugar；1/4-1/2 cup water
步骤：1. Start by cutting tomatoes into small wedges and finely chop the scallion. 2. Crack 4 eggs into a bowl and season with ¼ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon white pepper, ½ teaspoon sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon Shaoxing wine. Beat eggs for a minute. 3. Preheat the wok over medium heat until it just starts to smoke. Then add 2 tablespoons of oil and immediately add the eggs. Scramble the eggs and remove from the wok immediately. Set aside. 4. Add 1 more tablespoon oil to the wok, turn up the heat to high, and add the tomatoes and scallions. Stir-fry for 1 minute, and then add 2 teaspoons sugar, ½ teaspoon salt, and ¼ cup water (if your stove gets very hot and liquid tends to cook off very quickly in your wok, add a little more water). Add the cooked eggs. 5. Mix everything together, cover the wok, and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the tomatoes are completely softened. 6. Uncover, and continue to stir-fry over high heat until the sauce thickens to your liking. Serve!
技法：准备：5分钟；烹饪：5分钟；总用时：10分钟
提示：If you can’t find Shaoxing rice wine in your local grocery store, you can substitute a dry sherry or mirin (Japanese sweet rice wine).；Be sure to remove the stems.

steps.instruction: 准备食材。鸡蛋三个、中等大小西红柿两个。盐1克、糖2克、食用油适量。
将鸡蛋去皮打散、西红柿切小块备用。
锅中倒入适量底油，油热之后，倒入蛋液。
待鸡蛋稍稍凝固后，把鸡蛋推到一边。然后放到西红柿，煸炒匀均。
往锅里加少许糖煸炒匀均，然后大火收汁。
最后关火，放盐翻炒匀均即可装盘。

technique: 鸡蛋充分打散，炒至稍稍凝固即可，不要炒得过熟。
鸡蛋不盛出，推到锅的一边后直接加入西红柿。
加入少许糖后大火收汁。
关火后再放盐，以减少提前出汤。
tips: 来源提示鸡蛋与西红柿总重量约为 1:1，但食材表只给出 3 个鸡蛋和 2 个中等西红柿，未提供重量，不能据此自行换算。
来源提示蛋液可加一点水使鸡蛋滑嫩，但没有给出量；该水未列入正式食材表或六步做法，不应补造数值。
西红柿块不宜过大或过小；过大延长烹饪时间，过小容易大量出汤。
炒鸡蛋时油不能太少，油温也不要太低。
葱可少量使用，但来源不建议姜、蒜或鸡精；本份正式食材表与步骤均未实际使用葱。
糖用于中和西红柿酸味。

原料表：鸡蛋 三个；西红柿 2个。步骤另明确：盐1克；糖2克；食用油适量。
步骤：1. 准备食材。鸡蛋三个、中等大小西红柿两个。盐1克、糖2克、食用油适量。 2. 将鸡蛋去皮打散、西红柿切小块备用。 3. 锅中倒入适量底油，油热之后，倒入蛋液。 4. 待鸡蛋稍稍凝固后，把鸡蛋推到一边。然后放到西红柿，煸炒匀均。 5. 往锅里加少许糖煸炒匀均，然后大火收汁。 6. 最后关火，放盐翻炒匀均即可装盘。
提示：鸡蛋不用炒得太熟；蛋不盛出而推到一边；少许糖中和酸味；关火后放盐以减少出汤。

简介：西红柿炒鸡蛋的家常做法，食材简单步骤详细，食材 鸡蛋怎么做好吃 新手也能轻松学会。豆果美食有更多美食教程!

菜名：番茄炒蛋
- 鸡蛋和西红柿用量的比例。总的来讲，就是重量1：1。西红柿不要太多，太多容易出汤，太少又会减轻味道。
- 鸡蛋要充分打散。打至感觉没有阻力，表面有很多小气泡。
- 打鸡蛋的时候，还要往蛋液里少放一点水。这会炒出来的鸡蛋才滑嫩可口。
- 西红柿的块不要切的太大或太小。太大烹饪时间久，会影响鸡蛋鲜嫩的口感。太小又会出很多汤，影响成品效果。
- 炒鸡蛋时，油不能太少，油温也不要太低。
- 鸡蛋不用炒的太熟，稍稍凝固就可以了。因为还要炒西红柿。
- 鸡蛋不需要从锅中盛出。只需要将鸡蛋推到锅的一边，继续炒西红柿就行。这样鸡蛋不会因为变冷而影响口感。
- 关于要不要放葱、姜、蒜。葱可以放一点，但姜和蒜就不要放了。原汁原味的最好吃。鸡精也不建议放。
- 要放一点糖，糖可以中和西红柿的酸。口味会更好。

主要变体冲突：The Woks of Life 使用 4 个鸡蛋、4 个约 500 g 番茄，炒蛋后立即盛出；豆果使用 3 个鸡蛋、2 个中等西红柿，鸡蛋稍凝固后推到锅边、不盛出。两条路线不得混合。
调味与配料冲突：The Woks of Life 明确使用葱、白胡椒、芝麻油、绍兴酒、3 tbsp 分次食用油、2 tsp 糖和 1/4-1/2 cup 水；豆果正式六步仅明确盐 1 克、糖 2 克、食用油适量，未实际使用葱、姜、蒜或鸡精。不得把豆果的简化调味覆盖或拼接进主变体。
盐的时点冲突：The Woks of Life 把 1/4 tsp 盐加入蛋液，并在番茄阶段加入其余 1/2 tsp；豆果要求最后关火后再放盐。选择主变体后必须保持对应时点。
